ctx.x: And then, this was round about 11:00. They write

it all in longhand and had Chitterson in there and the man, when Evans says well, what, he doesn't know, so he let him go. Let Chitterson go. Chitterson says, what's happening now, and these people are known to cut people's heads off.

Chitterson says that man knows I wasn't doing nothing wrong. All right, but keep playing and breaking the house up, everybody's feeling good and everything -- everybody's getting whatever they needed. So, well, I had a friend come in from Sweden. She come down there to visit me and so I was happy as I could be.
